title: Colts’ Alec Pierce enters training camp on PUP list with Week 1 goal after ankle surgery

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts’ Alec Pierce enters training camp on PUP list with Week 1 goal after ankle surgery
sources.description: One of the best deep threats in the entire NFL, Alec Pierce, has been added to the physically unable to perform list as he recovers from offseason ankle surgery.
